button.supertip: Calculates every Calcpad expression in the document: main text first, then text boxes, notes, headers and footers. Later expressions use variables defined earlier. Text written as {= ... } is picked up too. The arrow below has Calculate automatically.

button.label: Calculate Now
button.supertip: Calculates every Calcpad expression in the document.

checkBox.label: Calculate automatically
checkBox.supertip: On (the default): leaving a changed input or expression recalculates the document. Off, as in Excel's manual mode: a changed input waits for Calculate (Ctrl+Alt+F9), which then reads Calculate (out of date); an expression you write or edit is calculated on its own, and what follows it waits. Saved with the document.

button.label: Cancel
button.supertip: Stops a calculation running in the background, or a math font being downloaded. Results already in the document keep their old values; Calculate calculates them again. Esc does the same while a calculation runs.

button.label: Convert to Calcpad
button.supertip: Turns the selected text, or the current paragraph, into Calcpad, then calculates. Each paragraph becomes one expression. A pasted Calcpad script becomes Word headings and text, with its calculations in Calcpad. With the keyboard shortcut on a result, it shows the source instead.

button.label: Calcpad Block
button.supertip: Keeps the selected paragraphs (or the current one) together as one multi-line Calcpad script, drawn by Calcpad: comments, headings, #if, loops, macros, plots and tables. On an empty line it starts an empty block to type into. You can also type a line with only {= , the script, and a line with only } . (Convert to Calcpad on a pasted script instead turns its headings and text into Word paragraphs.)

button.label: Block to Text
button.supertip: Replaces the Calcpad block at the cursor with Word content: its headings and text become Word paragraphs with the values inline, and only plots, tables and #if/loops stay in Calcpad blocks. Convert to Calcpad does this by itself when you paste a Calcpad script.

button.label: Edit Source
button.supertip: Shows the Calcpad source of the result at the cursor so you can change it. Click outside it, or press Alt+Shift+Enter, to calculate.

dynamicMenu.supertip: Lists the expressions that failed. Pick one to go to it; the error message is shown as you point at it.

button.label: Next Error
button.supertip: Moves the cursor to the next expression that failed. Its error message is shown in the status bar and as the expression's title.

button.label: Lock
button.supertip: Locks the Calcpad expressions and blocks in the selection (Ctrl+A for the whole document): they still calculate, but can't be opened, converted or deleted. Input fields stay open. A guard against accidental changes; Unlock lifts it.

button.label: Unlock
button.supertip: Unlocks the Calcpad expressions and blocks in the selection, so they can be edited again.

dropDown.label: Decimals
dropDown.supertip: Number of decimals in results. Calcpad keeps significant figures for small values.

checkBox.label: Substitute values
checkBox.supertip: Show the equation again with the values put in, before the result.

dropDown.label: Math font
dropDown.supertip: The font of all equations in this document (Word's own math font setting). A free font that isn't installed yet can be downloaded and installed for you, without administrator rights.

checkBox.label: Plain Word math
checkBox.supertip: Off: Calcpad look, with variable names in blue. On: plain black Word equations.

checkBox.label: Complex numbers
checkBox.supertip: Calcpad's Complex mode: i is the imaginary unit, so √(-4) = 2i, and A∠φ (or A<<φ) writes a phasor. Off, as in Calcpad: real numbers only. Saved in the document.
